method: Read-only offline unique run_id join of fresh results and historical http-uds-v7; compare payload hash, model, status and full answer objects; compare choice probabilities and noul values. Ignore timestamps/latency. No new inference or scoring run.
limits: Observed parity in this one fresh run, not proof of general determinism
Binary provenance is pinned only for fresh run; historical outputs remain historical
No controlled engine epoch, cache-free execution or mixed-chat isolation
Identical outputs do not establish causal improvement or calibration; native metrics remain tiny-sample estimates
